purpose_zh: 把既有普通人服务链、场景卡、空间锚点、发布门与资料就绪度并置为两种非尺度化的空间接口原型，便于审阅人工优先、停止动作和待补资料如何在同一空间叙事中出现。
purpose_en: Places the existing ordinary-person journey, scenario cards, spatial anchors, release gates, and data-readiness requirements into two non-scaled spatial-interface prototypes so a reviewer can see human priority, stop actions, and missing evidence together.
not_claimed_zh: 不是实际道路横断面、建筑平面、工程尺寸、路权或低空净空。
不是人员值守、真实可访问性、运行安全、许可、投资或实施承诺。
未取得清权 GIS/CAD、现状、道路、市政、权属和专业资料前，不把任一锚点当作官方红线或精确线位。
not_claimed_en: Not an actual street section, building plan, engineering dimension, right-of-way, or low-altitude clearance.
Not evidence of staffing, real accessibility, operational safety, permit, investment, or delivery.
Until cleared GIS/CAD, existing-condition, road, utility, rights, and professional inputs are available, no anchor is an official boundary or exact alignment.

prototypes.title_zh: 原点社区：人工等价服务与技能转型接口
prototypes.title_en: AI Origin Community: Equivalent Human Service and Skills-Transition Interface

interface_layers.label_zh: 无障碍步行与可停留边缘
interface_layers.readable_role_zh: 进入和选择的可见公共前场；不以扫码或 App 替代入口。
interface_layers.readable_role_en: Visible public forecourt for entry and choice; no QR code or app replaces entry.
interface_layers.human_priority_zh: 先保证可理解、可停留、可求助。
interface_layers.human_priority_en: Comprehension, dwell, and help come first.
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_zh: 路径受阻时改道或停留在人工服务，不把障碍归责给使用者。
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_en: Reroute or remain with human service when the path is blocked; do not assign the barrier to the user.

interface_layers.label_zh: 人工柜台、电话与纸面入口
interface_layers.label_en: Staffed counter, telephone, and paper entry
interface_layers.readable_role_zh: 与 AI 辅助并列的等价服务入口。
interface_layers.readable_role_en: An equivalent service entry alongside AI assistance.
interface_layers.human_priority_zh: 人工/电话/纸面可直接完成请求。
interface_layers.human_priority_en: Staffed, telephone, and paper routes can complete the request directly.
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_zh: 无人工等价入口时仅观察与补资料，不迁移为数字优先服务。
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_en: Without an equivalent human entry, observe and complete evidence only; do not migrate to digital-first service.

interface_layers.readable_role_zh: 把被替代风险劳动者和老人置于可见的学习、解释与转介链中。
interface_layers.readable_role_en: Makes learning, explanation, and referral visible for workers at displacement risk and older residents.
interface_layers.human_priority_zh: 不以培训人次替代带薪路径或就业结果。
interface_layers.human_priority_en: Training counts do not substitute for paid pathways or work outcomes.
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_zh: 缺经同意基线、带薪路径或随访时，相关结果保持 unknown。
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_en: Without consented baselines, paid pathways, or follow-up, outcomes remain unknown.

interface_layers.readable_role_zh: 为高强度劳动、老人和儿童提供不被强制交互的恢复空间。
interface_layers.readable_role_en: Offers restorative space without mandatory interaction for intensive workers, older people, and children.
interface_layers.human_priority_zh: 不采集情绪画像、不强制屏幕交互。
interface_layers.human_priority_en: No emotion profiling and no mandatory screen interaction.
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_zh: 出现强制采集、广告推荐或排斥风险时撤下相关场景。
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_en: Withdraw the related scene when compulsory collection, ad recommendation, or exclusion risk appears.

prototypes.title_zh: 众智园：人机测试与人工停止接口
prototypes.title_en: Zhongzhiyuan: Human–Machine Testing and Human-Stop Interface

interface_layers.label_zh: 人行优先缓冲与观察位
interface_layers.readable_role_zh: 把行人、无障碍使用者与观察者放在受控测试之前。
interface_layers.readable_role_en: Places pedestrians, accessibility users, and observers before controlled testing.
interface_layers.human_priority_zh: 人行优先、低速、可见状态。
interface_layers.human_priority_en: Pedestrian priority, low speed, and visible status.
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_zh: 安全事件或无障碍障碍时停止或改道。
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_en: Stop or reroute after a safety event or accessibility barrier.

interface_layers.label_zh: 人工停止与事故复盘庭
interface_layers.readable_role_zh: 让停止、交接、事故说明和独立复核有可见的公共接口。
interface_layers.readable_role_en: Makes stopping, handoff, incident explanation, and independent review publicly visible.
interface_layers.human_priority_zh: 现场人员可冻结自动化动作。
interface_layers.human_priority_en: On-site people can freeze automated action.
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_zh: 无人接管、责任不清或证据不可回放时回到前一发布门。
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_en: Return to the prior release gate when nobody can take over, responsibility is unclear, or evidence cannot replay.

interface_layers.label_zh: 受限硅基通行与 API 模拟接口
interface_layers.label_en: Bounded silicon passage and API simulation interface
interface_layers.readable_role_zh: 仅表达地点、时间、数据、责任四限定下的研究接口。
interface_layers.readable_role_en: Expresses a research interface only under place, time, data, and accountability bounds.
interface_layers.human_priority_zh: AI 只能建议，不能替代规划许可、执法或个人权益决定。
interface_layers.human_priority_en: AI may only advise; it cannot replace planning permission, enforcement, or personal-rights decisions.
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_zh: 授权、影响评估、日志、保险或人工接管不足时仅保留模拟或纸面协议。
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_en: Keep only simulation or paper protocol when authorization, impact review, logs, insurance, or human takeover is insufficient.

interface_layers.readable_role_zh: 将水文、蓝线和气候校准资料缺口显性留在测试扩展之前。
interface_layers.readable_role_en: Keeps missing hydrology, blue-line, and climate-calibration inputs visible before test expansion.
interface_layers.human_priority_zh: 地面公共安全与退避优先于测试效率。
interface_layers.human_priority_en: Ground-level public safety and retreat precede testing efficiency.
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_zh: 缺蓝线、排水/事件资料或校准模型时仅保留概念蓝绿空间。
interface_layers.stop_or_fallback_en: Keep only conceptual blue-green space without blue-line, drainage/event, or calibration-model evidence.

universal_rule_zh: 两个原型只把现有结构化锚点并置为可读空间关系；任一锚点、人工停止动作、资料门或独立复核不可解析时，不得把图示当作可运行、可许可或可扩展的结论。
universal_rule_en: The two prototypes only place existing structured anchors into readable spatial relationships; if any anchor, human-stop action, data gate, or independent review cannot resolve, the drawing cannot be treated as an operable, permitted, or scalable conclusion.
